note: Sanilac County's zoning districts appear only inside the FetchGIS county map viewer (app.fetchgis.com, zoning layer listing Marlette, Sandusky, Peck, Ubly and other municipal options). That viewer exposes no ArcGIS REST or downloadable zoning service, and the county's GIS pages link only to viewers. The county's ordinance page links to no zoning map. ArcGIS searches for Sanilac zoning found no district layer. The only parcel layer with attributes (mi_sanilac, an MSU-hosted copy) has zoning fields empty or set to 0, so it is not usable. No city zoning service (Sandusky, Marlette) was found.
